comment: Tier 1 of the internal eval set: the deterministic invariants the pre-push hook enforces.
No network, no model calls. Tier 2 (model-backed behavior) lives in evals/ and is opt-in.
test_count_baseline is a ratchet: the suite may grow, it may never shrink. A drop means a
module stopped being referenced from the test root and its tests silently vanished.
It is a FLOOR and nothing raises it automatically - bump it by hand at each release cut.
test_count_slack is how far the real suite may run ahead of that floor before the tests
check starts WARNING that the ratchet has stalled: it sat 350 behind for months (#439),
which is a floor low enough to catch nothing.

required_invariants.test: epochs: nextEpoch clears the live goal AND every parked epoch; currentEpoch 0 without a goal
required_invariants.why: #318: a new goal inherited the previous goal's checklist and was born done.

required_invariants.test: a replace keeps omitted completed items and still drops omitted open ones
required_invariants.why: 2896b32: a replace deleted completed items the model omitted, erasing finished work.

required_invariants.test: a write with zero usable items is rejected untouched, never completion evidence (#318)
required_invariants.why: 6300514: an empty todo_write wiped the checklist and read as completion.

required_invariants.test: /loop: a passed wall-clock deadline stops as expired and flips nothing
required_invariants.why: 6300514: a timed run past its deadline must stop as expired, not as accepted.

required_invariants.test: /loop: a restored all-[x] list is idle, not accepted (#318)
required_invariants.why: #318: a leftover finished checklist ended a fresh /loop at iteration 1.

required_invariants.test: /goal and /loop produce the same run; only /goal adopts the objective
required_invariants.why: 010b9ad: /goal and /loop are one autonomous run; they must not drift apart.

required_invariants.test: compactionSnapshot: no live goal, no checklist, and a capped render (#318)
required_invariants.why: #318: compaction dropped the goal and its completed items mid-run.

required_invariants.test: completionGate: open list refused once, no-checklist needs confirm, done list accepts, review exempt (#318)
required_invariants.why: #318: the model could claim completion over an unfinished checklist.

required_invariants.test: childTaskPrompt: the same absolute deadline reaches every child, minus a margin
required_invariants.why: d33c4a4: a timed /loop must hand its deadline down, or children outlive the run.
